baseline_models.focus_anchor: The nominal pairing of ٱلْجِبَالَ with أَوْتَادًا assigns the mountains a peg-function.
baseline_models.mechanism: A high solid mass is recast as a driven peg: its conspicuous elevation becomes the exposed part of a mechanism whose holding work implies planted depth.

activation_trace.role: The high solid mass supplies the visible bulk and exposed head of the mechanism.
The driven peg supplies insertion and fixing, recasting mountain bulk as a fastener.

changed_reading.after: Mountains are viewed by function as planted fasteners: visible mass above and implied holding depth below.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The mountain and peg branches converge on resistance, uprightness, and planted firmness.
baseline_models.mechanism: Mountain hardness marks where penetration stops, while peg-like planted stance marks what remains upright there; the image therefore stresses terminal resistance as well as fastening.

activation_trace.role: Hardness that stops digging supplies resistant depth and a terminal boundary.
Upright planted firmness supplies the stance maintained at that resistant boundary.

changed_reading.before: The peg comparison concerns shape alone.
changed_reading.after: The comparison also presents mountains as hard stops that resist penetration and maintain a planted stance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A branch of ج ب ل evokes firmly made weaving, while أَوْتَادًا supplies the driven fastener.
baseline_models.mechanism: Crossing the two branch images permits a textile-assembly model: mountains are fastening nodes in a tightly made fabric rather than isolated masses.

activation_trace.role: Firmly made woven cloth supplies an integrated fabric whose coherence can require fastening.
The driven peg supplies a fixing node for that fabric-like assembly.

changed_reading.before: Each mountain is an independent geological object.
changed_reading.after: The plural mountains can be imagined as multiple fixing points within one firmly assembled fabric.

context_deltas.mechanism: The coordinated focus inherits the making-frame of 78:6. Earth is assigned the function of prepared bedding, so the mountain-pegs acquire a relational job: holding a made, habitable spread rather than merely resembling stakes.

activation_trace.role: The high solid mass supplies the visible mountain body placed in relation to the ground.
The driven peg supplies the fastening action assigned to that body.
Making something assume a state supplies the governing operation that assigns environmental functions.
The lower ground opposite the sky supplies the substrate to which the fastening relation is applied.
A prepared, spread bedding supplies the surface that a peg can hold in place.

structural_cues: 78:7 begins with coordination and continues the interrogative making construction opened in 78:6.
The adjacent verses end in parallel indefinite accusative function-images, مِهَادًا and أَوْتَادًا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assigned making, lower ground, prepared bedding, and driven pegs; I supply the mechanical arrow that the pegs secure the spread. A live alternative is a list of adjacent benefits with no fastening relation between them.

changed_reading.before: The mountains are generic planted fasteners.
changed_reading.after: They are fasteners specifically for a prepared humanly habitable ground-system.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later covering and construction images scale the focus into a shelter mechanism: a garment-like night covers, an upper structure is assembled and tightened, and the mountain-pegs read as the lower fastening points of the inhabited enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Firm weaving supplies the focus-side image of a coherent fabric or rig.
Driven pegs supply the lower fastening points of the proposed enclosure.
Covering with a garment supplies a flexible enclosing layer around the inhabited space.
Building by joining parts supplies an assembled upper structure rather than an unorganized sky.
Tightening a bond or knot supplies tension and secure joining within that structure.

structural_cues: The focus stands between prepared ground and a sequence of covering, livelihood, and building images.
78:12 places the built strong structure above the audience, giving the sequence a lower-and-upper spatial frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering, assembled building, tightened bonds, and pegs; I join these separate images into a tent-like shelter rig and assign the pegs its anchoring role. They may instead be independent analogies in a catalog of provisions.

changed_reading.before: The woven-fastening possibility is only a branch-level image within 78:7.
changed_reading.after: The surrounding sequence makes the mountains legible as anchoring points in a built, covered cosmic habitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The rain-growth sequence runs downward and then outward: water is delivered and poured from above, then concealed life is brought out as plants. The vertical mountain-peg can therefore be explored as a fixed coupling point between descending provision and emergence from the ground.

activation_trace.role: The high solid mass supplies a vertical interface rising from the productive ground.
Planted upright firmness supplies a fixed connector spanning above-ground and below-ground zones.
Delivering something downward supplies the first directional movement in the cycle.
Conveying water by pouring or irrigation supplies the mobile medium crossing into the ground-system.
Pouring and downflow intensify the downward leg of the mechanism.
Bringing something out of concealment reverses the direction from inward descent to outward result.
Plants emerging from earth supply the visible upward product of the cycle.

structural_cues: 78:14 presents descent and abundant pouring; the purpose construction in 78:15 explicitly links that water to bringing out grain and vegetation.
The sequence moves spatially from above, into the ground, and back out into dense gardens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the downflow-to-emergence sequence and a planted vertical peg; I supply the arrow that the mountain-peg mediates or indexes this ecological transfer. A live alternative is that mountains and rain are adjacent signs with no hydrological role asserted between them.

changed_reading.before: The peg is a static stabilizer.
changed_reading.after: It can also be read as a fixed interface within a productive vertical system linking what descends to what emerges.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact mountain noun returns in 78:20, but the high solid masses are displaced and enter a water-like mirage state. The focus's peg-fixity is therefore functional and commissioned for the present order, not an intrinsic guarantee of permanence.

activation_trace.role: The high solid mass establishes the maximal visible solidity that the later scene reverses.
The driven peg establishes the present fixing function that can later be withdrawn.
Displacement and removal directly cancel the planted peg's operational stance.
The repeated high solid mass identifies the later object as the same category named in the focus.
Coming to presence in a time supplies a state transition rather than an eternal essence.
A mirage gleaming like water supplies the ungraspable result opposed to solid planted mass.

structural_cues: 78:20 repeats the focus noun ٱلْجِبَالُ and uses a passive displacement followed by a result clause, فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا.
The immediately preceding sky transformation has the same passive-then-result rhythm, marking coordinated dismantling of the built order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same mountains, their removal, and their mirage-result; I infer that the earlier peg-state is an installed role whose term can end. Whether 78:20 depicts material transformation or perceptual disappearance remains live, but either reading suspends their fastening function.

changed_reading.before: Calling mountains pegs implies that their stability is essential and permanent.
changed_reading.after: Their stability is a temporary assigned service within the present order, revocable at the appointed dismantling.

context_deltas.mechanism: Questioning, reported news, divergent paths, and promised disclosure frame the mountain-pegs as material evidence; the later language of visible signs and denial makes the focus an epistemic anchor that pins disputed speech to an inspectable created order.

activation_trace.role: A high solid landmark supplies conspicuous, publicly inspectable evidence.
The driven peg supplies the metaphorical work of fixing an otherwise mobile dispute to material evidence.
Mutual questioning supplies the unsettled discursive field into which the focus is introduced.
Incoming reported news supplies the contested claim requiring orientation.
Each party taking a different path supplies the mechanism of disagreement rather than mere ignorance.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the promised conversion from dispute to recognition.
A visible sign supplies the later category under which created evidence can be recognized.
Contradiction of truth supplies the active denial against which the material sign functions.

structural_cues: The creation questions of 78:6-7 directly follow the five-ayah sequence of questioning, dispute, and future knowing.
78:28 retrospectively names denied material as signs, though it does not specify that the mountain image alone is intended.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contested news, promised knowing, visible signs, denial, and a conspicuous fixed landmark; I assign the mountain-peg an evidentiary role in that argument. A live alternative is that it is simply one provision in a list and has no special epistemic privilege.

changed_reading.before: The verse is only a physical comparison.
changed_reading.after: It also operates as a concrete counter-sign that fixes contested discourse to an observable order and anticipates forced recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: A peg works by fitting its assigned place and holding joined material. Later, recompense matches action, calculation counts, exhaustive enumeration omits nothing, and a record fixes judgment. This activates a cross-domain reading of the mountain-pegs as an early material instance of calibrated correspondence.

activation_trace.role: Firm weaving supplies a made order whose parts are coherently joined.
The driven peg supplies a fitted fastener that holds the joined order in its assigned relation.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies a moral correspondence between deed and result.
An amount equal to its need or counterpart supplies exact measure and fit.
Counting and calculation supply the evaluative operation behind measured correspondence.
Exhaustive enumeration supplies completeness, preventing any element from escaping the measure.
A fixed record that obligates judgment supplies durable registration of the measured order.

structural_cues: The surah moves from compact predications of assigned created functions to compact predications of matching recompense and total accounting.
The physical order of 78:6-16 and the assessed order of 78:26-29 occupy distinct sequences, so their linkage is analogical rather than syntactically explicit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fitted fastening, matching recompense, counting, exhaustive enumeration, and fixed record; I supply the cross-domain arrow that physical fit images moral exactness. The two orders may be parallel demonstrations of control without sharing one mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Mountain-pegs express strength and stability only.
changed_reading.after: They can also image calibrated placement: every support fits its task just as every act later meets an exact account.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it depends on the packet's non-dominant ص و ب mapping to ن ص ب and transfers a material marker-image into speech; it remains anchored through the focus's planted peg and the packet's explicit erected-marker and exact-fit branches. Downstream prose should present it only as a split-root exploratory resonance, not claim that صَوَابًا lexically means a boundary stone here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The planted firmness of أَوْتَادًا can meet the later image of an erected marker whose truth fits its place.

activation_trace.role: The high solid landmark supplies the macroscopic visible marker.
Upright planted firmness supplies the stance of something correctly set in place.
The non-dominant split branch supplies an erected stone or boundary marker for the utterance of what is right.
Truth fitting its proper place like a joint or vessel supplies correctness as exact placement.

changed_reading.before: The mountain-pegs are only material supports.
changed_reading.after: They become an exploratory material analogy for right speech and truth: upright, visibly set, and fitted to the proper place.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because literal mountains are transferred into social organization; it remains anchored because a focus branch explicitly names chiefs as mountains, the peg branch supplies upright stance, and the context supplies human groups standing in a straight row. Render it as a social-topological analogy, never as a replacement translation of the focus.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A ج ب ل branch likens chiefs to mountains, while a و ت د branch supplies planted uprightness.

activation_trace.role: Chiefs likened to mountains supply socially prominent masses around which a group can be ordered.
Planted uprightness supplies the stance of stabilizing social posts.
Groups of people supply the collective material to be spatially organized.
Bodily upright standing supplies the vertical posture shared with the peg branch.
Alignment on a straight line supplies ordered rank rather than an unstructured crowd.

changed_reading.before: The plural mountains stabilize only physical terrain.
changed_reading.after: They can faintly image upright chief-pegs that give spatial order to gathered ranks.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it treats terrain as a body and activates an anatomical peg branch from later hearing and permission language; it remains anchored because the focus inventories explicitly pair thick bodily build with an ear projection called a peg. Downstream prose should qualify it as an auditory-body analogy only and should not translate mountains as ears or read anatomical meaning into أَذِنَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus inventories allow the thick body of ج ب ل to combine with the ear-projection branch of و ت د.

activation_trace.role: Thick bodily build supplies a body-scale substrate for the terrain analogy.
An ear projection likened to a peg supplies the precise anatomical protrusion.
The ear as the locus of hearing reactivates the focus's otherwise remote anatomical peg branch.
The ear organ and ear-like forms reinforce the anatomical resonance despite the contextual verb expressing permission.

changed_reading.before: The mountains are mechanical stakes in inert terrain.
changed_reading.after: They can momentarily appear as peg-like auricular projections on a thick terrain-body within a later field of regulated hearing and speech.

strongest_changes: The prepared-earth context turns a free-standing peg comparison into a relational mechanism that fastens habitable ground.
The covering and building sequence scales the pegs into lower anchors of a cosmic shelter rig.
The exact mountains' displacement into mirage revises peg-fixity from permanent essence to revocable assigned function.
The opening dispute and later signs/accounting extend the physical peg into epistemic anchoring and, more tentatively, calibrated moral fit.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package lets the same focus move from construction to dismantling while retaining several live mechanisms: structural fastening, shelter, ecological transfer, evidence, exact fit, and carefully contained split-root, social, and anatomical resonances.
remaining_uncertainties: The shelter rig may be one integrated material analogy or several adjacent provision-images.
The ecological coupler is a reader-supplied spatial mechanism; the packet does not state that mountains mediate rainfall or growth.
The moral-fit model and the non-dominant ص و ب marker activation should remain exploratory rather than lexical claims.
78:20 securely revokes operational fixity, but the packet leaves open whether its mirage-result is material dissolution, perceptual disappearance, or both.
